privacyPage.demo: Demonstration document — controller and service-provider details must be confirmed before publication.
privacyPage.controllerText: The data controller is {controller}. Privacy enquiries: {email}.
privacyPage.scopeText: The server may process technical connection data required to display the website securely. If you send an email or message, we process the contact information and correspondence you provide.
privacyPage.purposeText: Technical data is used for website security and maintenance, while correspondence data is used to answer and continue the enquiry. Data should be kept only for as long as necessary for these purposes or required by law.
privacyPage.analyticsText: Optional analytics remains disabled without consent. The website stores only your privacy choice locally. Embedded media players are not loaded — links to music services lead to external websites.
privacyPage.recipientsText: Technical data may be handled by hosting and security providers, while correspondence may be handled by email or messaging providers. The final provider list will be completed after domain and service configuration.
privacyPage.rightsText: You may request access, rectification, erasure or restriction of your data, object to processing and lodge a complaint with the competent supervisory authority. You can change optional analytics consent at any time.
